literal: A king who does not deliberate with the guidance of his associates, if he rages with anger guiding him, his wealth will diminish.
translation: The fortune of a king who does not deliberate with the counsel of his ministers, but instead rages and acts out of anger, will surely diminish.
modern: தன் அமைச்சர்களுடன் ஆராய்ந்து செயல்படாத அரசன், கோபத்தின் வழியே சென்று சீறினால், அவனுடைய செல்வம் சுருங்கிவிடும்.
explanation: This couplet warns rulers against acting without counsel and letting anger dictate their behavior. A wise king must deliberate on matters of state with his trusted ministers and associates. If he fails to do so and instead acts impulsively under the influence of anger, he will alienate his supporters and make poor decisions. Consequently, his prosperity and royal fortune will rapidly decline and diminish.
